address: Clos Vauban, 1 place du Colonel-de-Grouchy, Langres, 52200, France
bio: Martine and Laurent Petit have chosen to write a new chapter in their story on these premises that used to be an officers' mess – in an elegant townhouse next to the Porte des Moulins. The great chef has teamed up with Valentin Loison (in the kitchen) and Anaïs Bercegeay (front of house) to bring this ambitious project to life. Surrounded by a magnificent vegetable garden, the house has been turned into a hotel that accommodates two restaurants. At Mirabelle, the atmosphere is resolutely warm and convivial, providing the perfect setting for diners to savour the indulgent cuisine made with ingredients from the garden and small-scale local producers: think chicken pâté en croûte with black trumpet mushrooms, trout coated in a bread crust and cooked on one side, or roasted hazelnut millefeuil...
